name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Magento (Adobe Commerce) exposes a REST API with token-based authentication for developers to integrate and extend the platform.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 1.0a or token-based authentication; tokens are bearer tokens.
access_notes: Merchants create integrations in the admin to obtain OAuth credentials.

evidence.snippet: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Adobe Commerce / Magento 2 administration.
When a merchant creates and activates an integration, Commerce generates a consumer key, consumer secret, access token, and access token secret.
